name: Outer Wilds
short_description: A tiny solar system loops every 22 minutes; learn its secrets by exploring.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A tiny solar system loops every 22 minutes; learn its secrets by exploring.

identity.core_loop: Fly to a planet, explore, read, the sun explodes, wake up knowing more.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Wonder and curiosity; knowledge is the only upgrade.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Almost everything is in the world: the planets change over the loop; the ship log is the one overlay map of what you know.

identity.art_direction: Handmade cosy space, campfires and marshmallows.
identity.audio_mood: Banjo by the fire; instruments you can find in space.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Knowledge as progress, and a tiny world that changes on a clock. A campfire and banjo can make space feel safe.
